# SC Controller artwork

Unmodified controller and button images from
[kozec/sc-controller](https://github.com/kozec/sc-controller/tree/2e2fe855afff693950827a45637cea3290eae782),
commit `2e2fe855afff693950827a45637cea3290eae782`, kept at their upstream paths.
The project's code is GPL-2.0, but its [ADDITIONAL-LICENSES](ADDITIONAL-LICENSES)
places everything in `images/` (except `images/menu-icons`, which is not used
here) under the
[CC0 1.0 public-domain dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
No sc-controller code is used.

The launcher's controls window embeds them: the Xbox 360-style controller
drawing, the face, shoulder and Back/Start button glyphs, and the stick and
D-pad direction glyphs. The positions of the face buttons and other controls
come from the drawing's hidden `AREA_*` rectangles.
